items.q: In which phase of meiosis do homologous chromosomes pair up and crossing over occur?
items.qAf: In watter fase van meiose paar homoloë chromosome en vind kruisoorvleueling plaas?
items.explain: Homologous chromosomes pair and exchange segments during prophase I.
items.explainAf: Homoloë chromosome paar en ruil segmente tydens profase I uit.

items.q: A human body cell has 46 chromosomes. How many chromosomes are in a gamete?
items.qAf: ’n Menslike liggaamsel het 46 chromosome. Hoeveel chromosome is in ’n gameet?
items.explain: Meiosis halves the chromosome number, so the gamete has 23.
items.explainAf: Meiose halveer die chromosoomgetal, dus het die gameet 23.

items.q: How many daughter cells are produced from one primary spermatocyte after meiosis?
items.qAf: Hoeveel dogterselle word uit een primêre spermatosiet na meiose gevorm?
items.explain: Meiosis I and II together produce four haploid cells from one diploid cell.
items.explainAf: Meiose I en II saam lewer vier haploïede selle uit een diploïede sel.

items.q: Which process produces new combinations of alleles on the same pair of chromosomes?
items.qAf: Watter proses produseer nuwe kombinasies van allele op dieselfde paar chromosome?
items.explain: Crossing over exchanges alleles between homologous chromosomes, creating new combinations.
items.explainAf: Kruisoorvleueling ruil allele tussen homoloë chromosome uit en skep nuwe kombinasies.

items.q: How many different combinations of chromosomes can gametes have if n = 3 pairs of homologous chromosomes assort independently?
items.qAf: Hoeveel verskillende kombinasies van chromosome kan gamete hê as n = 3 pare homoloë chromosome onafhanklik sorteer?

items.q: Which TWO events together produce genetic variation in meiosis?
items.qAf: Watter TWEE gebeurtenisse saam veroorsaak genetiese variasie in meiose?
items.explain: Crossing over and independent assortment both create new allele combinations in gametes.
items.explainAf: Kruisoorvleueling en onafhanklike sortering skep albei nuwe allelkombinasies in gamete.
